# Execution quality: daily TCA
**How to use:** the session date is the `trade_day` notebook variable (Variables button), e.g. `'2026-11-11'` or `'$yesterday'`. **Exception:** the console does not inject notebook variables into HORIZON JOIN cells, so the markout cells start with their own `DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'` line (and `@cpty` in the drill-down). Change that first line in each of those cells as well. Refresh is off; re-run after changing a date.

**Method:** markout = signed (mid − fill px) / px in bps, positive = good for us. The reference mid comes from the primary venue's quotes (CME / ICE / ICE_ENDEX; EEX is excluded because it is a secondary listing). *At fill* = spread paid (−) or earned (+). Adverse selection ("picked off") = markout getting worse in the **first seconds** after the fill. A loss that only shows up after minutes is market direction, not pick-off. USD values use approximate FX (GBPUSD 1.3287, EURUSD 1.107; NBP is quoted in pence per therm).

**11 Nov 2026 findings:** (1) Exchange fills show no pick-off at any venue: the 5s minus at-fill drift is between −0.1 and +0.2 bp. (2) The large red trades are the **09:30–09:50 UTC gas/power repricing** (NBP, TTF and UKPWR fronts up 6–7% in a smooth 20-minute climb; Brent flat). It is a directional loss on sells, not execution. (3) The real adverse-selection signal is in **voice/broker flow with UTILITY_02**: 6 of 6 trades lost money within 5 minutes, about −$113k. (4) Not execution problems: a manual TTF Q1-27 mark ~300 bp above market (trader_11), a duplicate BANK_02 booking, a JKM 500k→50k qty correction, and OTC trades booked hours late.

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'
WITH mk AS (
SELECT f.trade_id, f.venue, f.passive, f.fct, f.qty, f.px,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) m0,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=1000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) m1s,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=5000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) m5s,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=60000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) m1m,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) m5m,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN f.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)*f.fct END) usd0,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000000 THEN f.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)*f.fct END) usd5m
FROM (SELECT ts, trade_id, venue, passive, qty, px, symbol,
   CASE curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END fct
   FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @trade_day) f
HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (0, 1s, 5s, 1m, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY f.trade_id, f.venue, f.passive, f.fct, f.qty, f.px)
SELECT venue, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS side_type, count() fills,
 round(sum(abs(qty*px*fct))/1e6, 1) notional_musd,
 round(avg(m0),2) bps_at_fill, round(avg(m1s),2) bps_1s, round(avg(m5s),2) bps_5s, round(avg(m1m),2) bps_1m, round(avg(m5m),2) bps_5m,
 round(avg(m5s-m0),2) adverse_5s, round(sum(usd0)) usd_at_fill, round(sum(usd5m)) usd_5m
FROM mk GROUP BY venue, side_type ORDER BY venue, side_type
cells.name: Exchange fills: markout ladder by venue and passive/aggressive (bps, USD)

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'
SELECT h.offset / 1000000000.0 AS horizon_s, f.venue || CASE WHEN f.passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggressive' END AS bucket,
 avg(10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px) AS markout_bps
FROM (energy_fills WHERE ts IN @trade_day) f
HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (-30s, -10s, -5s, -1s, 0, 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1m, 2m, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY horizon_s, bucket ORDER BY horizon_s, bucket
cells.name: Markout curve: −30s … +5m around exchange fills (bps)

WITH b AS (SELECT ts, symbol, close FROM energy_quotes_1m WHERE ts IN @trade_day AND symbol IN ('NBP_Dec-26','TTF_Jan-27','UKPWR_Jan-27','BRENT_Jan-27','EUA_Dec-26')),
o AS (SELECT symbol, first(close) open_px FROM b GROUP BY symbol)
SELECT b.ts, b.symbol, round(100 * (b.close / o.open_px - 1), 3) AS pct_from_open FROM b JOIN o ON b.symbol = o.symbol ORDER BY b.ts
cells.name: Front-month moves, % from session open (1m mid)

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'
WITH mk AS (
SELECT f.trade_id, f.ts, f.curve, f.fct, f.qty, f.px,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN f.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)*f.fct END) usd0,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000000 THEN f.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)*f.fct END) usd5m
FROM (SELECT ts, trade_id, curve, qty, px, symbol,
   CASE curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END fct
   FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @trade_day) f
HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (0, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY f.trade_id, f.ts, f.curve, f.fct, f.qty, f.px)
SELECT timestamp_floor('1h', ts::timestamp) AS hour, curve, round(sum(usd5m - usd0)) AS usd_post_trade_5m
FROM mk GROUP BY hour, curve ORDER BY hour, curve
cells.name: Post-trade P&L (USD, 5m markout minus at-fill) by hour and curve

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'
WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE channel != 'EXCH' LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id),
e AS ((SELECT trade_ts, trade_id, symbol, curve, qty, px, channel, counterparty,
   CASE curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END fct
   FROM l WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @trade_day ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
mk AS (
SELECT e.trade_id, e.counterparty, e.qty, e.px, e.fct,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END) b0,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=60000000 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END) b1m,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END) b5m,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000 THEN e.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)*e.fct END) usd5m
FROM e HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (e.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (0, 1m, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY e.trade_id, e.counterparty, e.qty, e.px, e.fct)
SELECT counterparty, count() trades, sum(CASE WHEN b5m < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) losers_5m,
 round(sum(abs(qty*px*fct))/1e6,1) notional_musd, round(avg(b0),2) bps_at_trade, round(avg(b1m),2) bps_1m, round(avg(b5m),2) bps_5m, round(sum(usd5m)) usd_5m
FROM mk GROUP BY counterparty ORDER BY usd_5m
cells.name: OTC + broker counterparty scorecard (latest version, cancels excluded)

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11', @cpty := 'UTILITY_02'
WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE channel != 'EXCH' LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id),
e AS ((SELECT trade_ts, trade_id, symbol, curve, qty, px, channel, counterparty, trader,
   datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts) booking_lag_min,
   CASE curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END fct
   FROM l WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @trade_day AND counterparty = @cpty ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts))
SELECT e.trade_ts, e.channel, e.trader, e.symbol, e.qty, e.px, e.booking_lag_min,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END),2) bps_at_trade,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=60000000 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END),2) bps_1m,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000 THEN 10000*sign(e.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)/e.px END),2) bps_5m,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000 THEN e.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-e.px)*e.fct END)) usd_5m
FROM e HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (e.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (0, 1m, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY e.trade_ts, e.channel, e.trader, e.symbol, e.qty, e.px, e.booking_lag_min ORDER BY e.trade_ts
cells.name: Counterparty drill-down: trades with @cpty

DECLARE @trade_day := '2026-11-11'
WITH mk AS (
SELECT f.ts, f.trader, f.symbol, f.venue, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, f.fct,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=0 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) bps_at_fill,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=5000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) bps_5s,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000000 THEN 10000*sign(f.qty)*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)/f.px END) bps_5m,
 avg(CASE WHEN h.offset=300000000000 THEN f.qty*(mid(q.bid,q.ask)-f.px)*f.fct END) usd_5m
FROM (SELECT ts, trader, venue, passive, qty, px, symbol,
   CASE curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END fct
   FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @trade_day) f
HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('CME','ICE','ICE_ENDEX')) q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol)
LIST (0, 5s, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY f.ts, f.trader, f.symbol, f.venue, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, f.fct)
SELECT ts, trader, symbol, venue, passive, qty, px, round(bps_at_fill,2) bps_at_fill, round(bps_5s,2) bps_5s, round(bps_5m,2) bps_5m, round(usd_5m) usd_5m
FROM mk ORDER BY usd_5m LIMIT 25
cells.name: Worst 25 exchange fills by 5m USD markout

SELECT e.booked_ts, e.status, e.reason, e.channel, e.counterparty, e.trader, e.booked_by, e.symbol, e.trade_ts, o.qty AS orig_qty, e.qty, o.px AS orig_px, e.px, o.booked_ts AS orig_booked_ts
FROM energy_trade_events e JOIN energy_trade_events o ON o.trade_id = e.trade_id AND o.version = 1
WHERE e.version > 1 AND e.trade_ts IN @trade_day ORDER BY e.booked_ts
cells.name: Not execution: amendments and cancellations

cells.value:
SELECT channel, count() trades, round(avg(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts))/60.0, 1) avg_lag_min, round(max(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts))/60.0, 1) max_lag_min,
 sum(CASE WHEN datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts) > 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) booked_over_1h_late
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE version = 1 AND trade_ts IN @trade_day GROUP BY channel
cells.name: Not execution: booking latency by channel

cells.value:
WITH mm AS (SELECT ts, symbol, marked_by, price FROM energy_curve_marks WHERE ts IN @trade_day AND source = 'MANUAL')
SELECT mm.symbol, mm.marked_by, min(mm.ts) first_mark, max(mm.ts) last_mark, count() minutes,
 round(avg(mm.price),3) avg_manual_mark, round(avg(b.close),3) avg_market_mid, round(avg(10000*(mm.price - b.close)/b.close),1) avg_gap_bps
FROM mm LEFT JOIN energy_quotes_1m b ON b.symbol = mm.symbol AND b.ts = mm.ts
GROUP BY mm.symbol, mm.marked_by
cells.name: Not execution: manual curve marks vs market mid
